title: The Wynn Phuket
shortDescription: A small gated collection of single-storey pool villas in the Pasak area of Cherng Talay.
description: The Wynn Phuket is a small gated collection of single-storey tropical-modern pool villas in the Pasak area of Cherng Talay, with villas on plots of roughly 478 to 732 sqm. The advertised 3-bedroom, 4-bathroom villas have around 435 sqm of built-up area, vaulted timber ceilings and open-plan living leading to a private pool and garden. Boat Avenue, Porto De Phuket and the Bang Tao and Layan beaches are in the surrounding area. Foreign buyers can hold via a 30-year renewable lease; freehold is for Thai buyers or companies.
